:::{#def-lik-factor}
#### Likelihood component (likelihood factor)

For a dataset $\vx$ of mutually independent observations,
the **likelihood component** (or **likelihood factor**)
of observation $\Rvar_\iobs = \rvar_\iobs$
is the likelihood of that observation alone:

$$\Lik_\iobs(\param) \eqdef \p(\Rvar_\iobs = \rvar_\iobs \mid \param)$$

:::
